A: Sofia has set aside her final three hundred dollars to insure the camera she uses for paid wedding photography. Y: A laboratory owner can sign a profitable contract to manufacture a refrigerant that is legal but releases potent greenhouse gases when equipment leaks. X: Dev volunteered to coordinate a river cleanup and is the only person with keys to the equipment shed. He wakes with a fever and aching muscles on the morning seventy volunteers are due to arrive. Y: Young farmer Mira wants to replace part of the family wheat field with the herbs she enjoys growing and has already found local buyers. X: The water department can reopen a repaired neighborhood pipe by noon if supervisor Beth approves the standard pressure test. X: A football club can earn a large fee by replacing its grass training fields with heated artificial turf.
